description: This file defines the 'Query' interface in the 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.query' package, outlining methods to build and manipulate query objects with criteria, sorting, limiting, and skipping features.

classes.name: Query
classes.description: An interface representing a query with methods to retrieve criteria, sort options, limits, skips, and to replace criteria.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the criteria of the query.

methods.name: getSortOptions
methods.description: Returns the list of sort options for the query.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit on the number of results.

methods.name: getSkip
methods.description: Returns the number of results to skip from the beginning.

methods.name: withCritera
methods.description: Default deprecated method to replace criteria, delegates to withCriteria.

methods.name: withCriteria
methods.description: Replaces the criteria of the query with a new one, returning a new Query instance.
